Title: Part 3: The Golden Hall
Text: It looks like Saruman took over the mind of king Theoden. Maybe Gandalf can heal him. I have to make sure no one is interrupting him.

pages:
You and Gandalf healed my uncle! I am forever in your dept. The people of Edoras finally have their king back.

We also banned Grima from the lands. I never felt comfortable close to him. I'm glad he is gone.

I miss Eomer, I hope he will soon come back.

I will now spend time with my uncle and mourn the death of his son Thèodred.
He needs me now, the people of Rohan need me. I have to stay strong.

Your Eowyn.

CompleteText: Now Gandalf can heal king Theoden. It looks like its working already, I should speak to the King.
